Applied to its earnings per share of ₹10.66 in Q1FY27 (₹42.64 for a full year), a share would be worth ₹658.63 (low), ₹798.60 (middle) or ₹969.21 (high).
Against the top of the price band, ₹272, the middle value means 193.6% upside.
Q1FY27 covers only part of a year; scaling it up assumes the rest of the year goes the same way.
